d: On 17 July 2024, a helicopter carrying both of Maharashtra's deputy chief ministers flew into thick cloud on its way from Nagpur to Gadchiroli. One of them panicked. The other calmly told him not to worry, saying he had survived six such accidents. The calm one was Devendra Fadnavis. The one who was scared was Ajit Pawar. A year and a half later, on the morning of 28 January 2026, Ajit Pawar was in the air again, this time in a private Learjet over Baramati. The cockpit told the tower the runway was not yet in sight. Minutes later the plane crashed beside the runway, and none of the five…
